sections.title: Why is my PC slow?
sections.words: Your processor is 91% busy and your memory (RAM) is 81% full (13.0 GB of 16.0 GB). Using the processor most: Jarvis's AI model (38%), chrome (30%) and Teams (5%). Using memory (RAM) most: chrome (2.5 GB), Teams (0.7 GB) and Jarvis's AI model (0.4 GB). The processor is nearly flat out - that is the likely reason. Jarvis's own AI model is one of them - it works hardest while it is answering.
